items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Danny Barker) does not mention Miss Artis in his own turns. The name appears only in the interviewer's turn as a parenthetical clarification '(Miss Artis?)' regarding a house in Chicago. There is no evidence in the transcript that Danny Barker knew, met, or had any relationship with

ctx.x: Teddy recommended Keg Johnson. They had all been living in the same house together, Miss Artis(?), in Chicago, see -- you know, old buddies -- and had been working on the same gig. So they sent for Keg Johnson. Now, Keg was my biggest friend. So my heart was broken because nobody had sent for me. You see? Then Keg Johnson gets in Benny Carter's band, as you say. And when you get in there, as Danny said, this is where everybody's looking. You're in the laboratory now. Anybody who is looking to get some musicians…
